description: This file defines the XGraphicsState class, which encapsulates the internal graphics state used within the PDFsharp library for drawing operations. It serves as a handle for restoring graphics contexts and accommodates platform-specific implementations for GDI and WPF.

classes.name: XGraphicsState
classes.description: Represents the internal state of an XGraphics object, used for context restoration in PDFsharp.

methods.name: XGraphicsState()
methods.description: Constructor for WPF or CORE platforms, initializes a new instance of XGraphicsState.

methods.name: XGraphicsState(GraphicsState? state)
methods.description: Constructor for GDI platform, initializes a new instance of XGraphicsState with a specified GraphicsState.
